namespace: Control temporal, duration and Cron picker commit policy
default: false for date, time and date-time; true for duration and Cron
effect: false commits picker selections immediately; true stages the picker draft until OK or Apply and lets Cancel discard it
precedence: selected Control local boolean, including false, overrides flat config.showActions; removed jsonformsExtended.showActions is ignored

namespace: Selected Control picker and composite-dialog confirm text
default: OK for date/time/date-time; Apply for duration and composite editors
effect: changes the confirmation action's visible and accessible label without changing its commit semantics
precedence: selected temporal/duration Control local text overrides flat config.okLabel; composite dialogs use only selected cell or position options; removed jsonformsExtended.okLabel is ignored
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte-{flowbite,shadcn,skeleton}/src/lib/controls/{Date,Time,DateTime}ControlRenderer.svelte, corresponding -extended Duration controls, and composite dialogs; Cron uses its own localized actions

namespace: Selected Control picker and composite-dialog cancel text
effect: changes the discard action's visible and accessible label without changing cancellation or stored data
precedence: selected temporal/duration Control local text overrides flat config.cancelLabel; composite dialogs use only selected cell or position options; removed jsonformsExtended.cancelLabel is ignored
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte-{flowbite,shadcn,skeleton}/src/lib/controls/{Date,Time,DateTime}ControlRenderer.svelte, corresponding -extended Duration controls, and composite dialogs; Cron uses its own localized actions
